verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents official SDK/toolkit paths (Agents Toolkit CLI, Bot Framework/Teams quickstarts, Microsoft Graph API, agent creation templates) enabling AI-native developers to build agents/bots for Teams, plus Copilot integration via Graph and Work IQ. However, the evidence is entirely first-party docs with no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality or developer experience, and community evidence focuses on end-user UX complaints rather than SDK/agentic development. Missing for 10: independent developer reviews or hands-on validation of the SDKs, clearer distinction between legacy Bot Framework SDK and newer Agents SDK, and evidence of adoption/quality from third-party agent builders.
